messages:
elaine: FYI the RCA for the 2026-03-22 multi-region routing blip is live (internal): https://redwood.app/rcas/1966-routing-blip. Short summary: control-plane race + stale routing table caused ~18 minutes of 502s for cross-region requests. Hotpatch deployed at 09:22 UTC. Please review and flag omissions.

noah: Thanks. Quick question on customer impact stats 18 orgs 60k requests 18 minutes  is that peak or total?

elaine: Good catch  it's peak affected orgs during the incident window. Total affected requests ~60k, peak error rate hit ~14% for the traffic slice routed across regions.

parth: I'll take owner for the routing-table reconciliation automation (owner: parth). ETA: 2026-03-31. Will add retries and backoff for control-plane updates.

ops-bot: Action created: PM-1966-1 routing-reconcile (parth), DEV-1966-2 controlplane-mutex (sasha).

sasha: I'll own the control-plane mutex audit and add a lightweight leader-election check (owner: sasha). ETA: 2026-03-29.

elaine: Action list in the doc: - routing-reconcile: add reconciliation loop + alert on stale entries (parth) due 2026-03-31 - controlplane-mutex: audit and leader-check (sasha) due 2026-03-29 - deploy-rollback-playbook: make rollback procedures explicit in runbook (elaine) due 2026-03-26

noah: Request: schedule a follow-up review 1 week after the last due date to ensure action items are closed and checks are passing. Suggest 2026-04-06 14:00 UTC.

elaine: Done. Created calendar: 2026-04-06 14:00 UTC. Invite sent to participants + eng-oncall.

parth: Also flag for metrics  add dashboard panel showing cross-region error ratio and control-plane latency. I'll add the dashboard PR.

sasha: I'll update the deployment pipeline to include a short canary for cross-region routes.

noah: I'll draft the public-facing status note and work with CS on org outreach. Aim to publish tomorrow morning.

elaine: Thanks all. If you see related spikes in canary or control-plane latency, ping #eng-sre immediately. Adding short checklist at bottom of RCA for oncall steps. :megaphone:
